string.text: How long travel notifications stay on screen (seconds). See PDA Guide > Addons > Fast Travel for travel rules.
Prevents crossing a level transition (on foot or via fast travel) while an alerted enemy is actively engaging you within your outer ambush range. On by default.
Show Ambush Range on PDA Map

Draw two yellow rings on the PDA map for your ambush ranges. Outer = main range (needs line of sight). Inner = 50% of outer (triggers even without line of sight). On ambush, only the ring that caught you turns red. Both scale with time, weather, and travel mode. On by default.
PDA map fast travel with pathing, ambushes, and sneak travel. Right-click a destination on the map to travel.
